title: McDonald mocked in congressional hearings after the Michigan flap

tellings.quote: And a congressman like famously like mocked that he was into UFOs and stuff like that. And like apparently the entire like congressional hall like was laughing at him.

plain: In 1966, after a wave of UFO sightings in Michigan, a scientist named James McDonald was supposedly mocked by a congressman for being into UFOs, and the whole hall laughed at him. A researcher who goes by RedPandaKoala tells Michels this without naming a source. It's told as an example of how serious people who took UFOs seriously were ridiculed in public.
